column2: Getting started
Ready in 3 minutes
Here's how to start
Open More → Profile & weight and enter your age, height, sex, weight and activity level.
Open More → Goals & nutrition and choose your goal, e.g. lose weight or build muscle. The app works out your daily calories and protein from it.
Under Training you choose a training plan, under Plan you fill your food week.
In Today you log what you eat. Done!
How the app is organised

At the bottom you'll find five sections: Today (log food), Plan (food week, shopping, recipes), Training (strength and running), Progress (weight and analysis) and More (settings). You can also swipe left and right to switch between sections.
Your data
Everything you enter stays on your phone. You don't need an account. Only if you switch on the leaderboard or cloud backup yourself is anything sent to our server.
Windows that slide up from the bottom can be closed by swiping them down – or with the Cancel button.
The app also works without internet. Only barcode search, photo analysis, leaderboard and cloud need a connection.
At the top of each section you'll find a ? – it opens the matching guide directly.
Logging food
Today: meals, calories and nutrients
What you see at the top
The ring shows how many calories you have left today. Below it are protein, carbohydrates and fat compared with your daily goal.
Add food
Tap + Add … on a meal or the + Food button at the bottom.
Choose the meal at the top: breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack.
Choose one of five ways: Analyse photo, Scan barcode, Search foods, Dish from the list or Enter yourself.
Enter the amount and confirm. The entry appears straight away under the meal.
Scan barcode
Tap Scan barcode. The camera starts by itself.
Hold the barcode on the pack inside the frame. The app recognises it automatically.
Check the amount in grams and tap Add. If the app can't find a product, you can also type in the number.
Log faster
Under Recently eaten you log a food again with + Again.
Copy everything from yesterday copies the whole previous day.
If a dish is in your weekly plan, one tap ticks it off as eaten.
Deleting entries and other days
Use the ✕ next to an entry to delete it. Use the date bar at the top to change the day, and the arrows to change the week.
Above the daily overview you see your streak: how many days in a row you've logged your food.
For photo analysis you need your own Google key (see the “Photo analysis” chapter).
Water & supplements
Tick off drinks and supplements
Water
In Today, scroll down to the water card.
Tap + Glass or + Bottle when you've had something to drink.
Use Goal in the card to change your daily water goal.
Supplements
In the supplement card, choose your supplements from the list or create your own with + Add your own supplement.
Tick off what you've taken.
With For the whole week you apply the selection to every day.
Under More → Reminders the app can remind you to drink.
Planning your food week
Plan → Week: dishes and weekly suggestion
Plan the week yourself
Open Plan → Week and choose a day at the top.
Tap + Add dish on a meal and pick a recipe or your own dish.
At the bottom you see whether the day fits your calorie and protein goal.
Fill the week automatically
Tap Weekly suggestion.
The app fills the whole week with dishes that fit your goals. Your favourites come up more often, blocked dishes never.
Don't like a dish? Remove it and add another one.
Anything in your weekly plan can later be ticked off as eaten under Today with one tap.
The free version includes 2 automatic weekly suggestions per month; Premium is unlimited.
Shopping list
Plan → Shopping: automatically from your plan
How it works
Plan your week first. The shopping list is created from it automatically.
Open Plan → Shopping. All ingredients are sorted by aisle, and the amounts are already added up.
In the shop, tick off what's in your trolley.
Mark what you still have at home as Already in stock.
Use Share list to send it on, e.g. via WhatsApp to your partner.
Recipes & custom dishes
Plan → Dishes: almost 3,000 recipes
Finding recipes
Open Plan → Dishes.
Search for a name or choose a category.
Tap a recipe to see ingredients, nutritional values and preparation.
Favourites and block list
In the recipe, tap ★ Favourite if you like it – it will then come up more often in the weekly suggestion. Mark dishes you don't want with 🚫 Never suggest.
Custom dish
Tap + Create your own dish.
Enter a name and add the ingredients with amounts. The app calculates the nutritional values itself.
Save – the dish is now in your list and available in the weekly plan.
Choosing a training plan
Training → Strength → Plan
Pick a plan
Open Training, choose Strength at the top and then Plan.
Filter by the number of training days and your level.
Choose one of the plans. It then applies to all upcoming weeks.
Adjust the week
Under Week you see which exercises are due on which day. With Re-plan week you redistribute the sessions, e.g. if you can train on different days this week.
Exercises
Under Exercises you'll find all exercises by muscle group and your history for each exercise. With Custom exercise you create a new one, with Add exercise you add it to your workout.
In the free version you can apply 2 plans automatically per month; Premium is unlimited.
During training
Log sets, rest, instructions, personal bests
Log sets
Open Training → Strength → Today. Today's exercises are listed there.
Last time's weights are already filled in. Adjust weight and reps if needed.
Tick off the set when you're done. The rest timer then starts by itself.
Use + Set to add another set.
Rest
The rest bar at the bottom shows the remaining time. When the rest is over, your phone gives a signal. During the rest you can play a short game (see “Break games”).
Doing the exercise correctly
Tap the name of an exercise. You'll see a 3D figure with the trained muscles glowing red, and step-by-step instructions.
Personal bests
If you manage more than ever before, the app celebrates your new personal best. With 📸 Share you turn it into an image for Instagram or WhatsApp.
You set the rest length under More → Training & rest.
Only sets you've actually ticked off count for the leaderboard and your streak.
Smart training
Progression, plateau and deload week
Progression suggestion
If you managed all reps last time, the app suggests more weight or more reps. One tap applies the suggestion.
Plateau
If you don't progress on an exercise for 3 sessions, you get a hint. From 4 sessions the app suggests rebuilding with a little less weight (90%).
After 6 weeks in a row or with several plateaus, the app suggests a light week at about 60% weight. After that you continue with your old weights – usually with new strength.
Rest per exercise
If your reps drop a lot from set to set, the app suggests a longer rest for that exercise.
All suggestions are optional. You can always ignore them.
Break games & levels
Play during your rest, XP and achievements
Start a game
Tick off a set – the rest starts.
In the rest bar, tap 🎮 Play.
Choose a game or use Quick start. It picks a game that fits the remaining rest time.
